Kassadin|mid.identity: Magic damage assassin who scales very hard. Null Sphere (Q) deals damage, interrupts channels and gives him a magic shield, Nether Blade (W) empowers his attacks and restores mana, Force Pulse (E) slows in a cone (it charges up when abilities are cast near him), and Riftwalk (R) teleports him; each Riftwalk in quick succession costs more mana but deals more damage. His passive reduces magic damage taken and lets him pass through units.
Kassadin|mid.playstyle: Scaling mid: he suffers through his lane, then becomes a huge threat from level 11 and especially 16. Weak against physical assassins and fighters early.
Kassadin|mid.early_game: Farm safely with Q and W, and accept losing a bit of lane against aggressive champions. Q interrupts channels and gives you a shield against abilities. Against magic damage mages, your passive and shield help you hold.
Kassadin|mid.level_1: Null Sphere (Q) first. Farm and magic shield.
Kassadin|mid.level_2: Nether Blade (W). An empowered attack and mana: last hit safely.
Kassadin|mid.level_3: Force Pulse (E). A cone slow: useful to escape or poke when it's charged.
Kassadin|mid.level_6: Riftwalk: teleportation. First roams possible and a dodging tool, but Kassadin stays fragile before his items. His big breakpoints are levels 11 and 16 (Riftwalk ranks).
power_spikes: Level 16: Kassadin becomes a huge late-game threat.
First completed item: sustain and damage.
Kassadin|mid.lane_plan: Farm, survive and accept being behind in gold: your strength comes later. Keep the wave near your tower against physical assassins. After level 6, use R to dodge ganks. The mid role quest (faster recall) helps you reset often to hold the lane.
Kassadin|mid.trading: Before 6: Q on your opponent, W to last hit, no all-ins. After 11: R → W → Q → E. Engage when your opponent no longer has their CC; give up on it against physical fighters who burst you (Zed, Talon, Pantheon).
threats: Physical assassins and fighters (Zed, Talon, Pantheon, Qiyana).
Tristana and Akshan, who harass you from range.
Games that end before you scale.
mistakes: Dying and losing XP before your key levels.

matchup_notes.Ahri: Your Q shield absorbs her magic burst.
matchup_notes.Zed: Farm under your tower and keep R for his ultimate.

Kassadin|mid.mid_game: Farm and roam with R once you have your core items. Avoid 5v5 fights before level 11.
Kassadin|mid.late_game: The main late-game threat: dive the carries with R, then get out with another Riftwalk.
Kassadin|mid.ahead: Roam with R, hunt the carries and take objectives.
Kassadin|mid.behind: Farm and scale: Kassadin makes up for being behind in the late game.
Kassadin|mid.win_condition: To win this game, you want to survive the lane, reach level 16 and dominate the late game.
Kassadin|mid.final_tip: Accept being behind in lane: every level you reach alive brings you closer to your level 16 spike.
